issues.description: Script uses 'set -eu' but is missing '-o pipefail'. All shell scripts must use 'set -euo pipefail' as the safe mode. Without pipefail, a failure in a pipeline component (e.g., 'echo ... | grep ...') would not be caught, potentially masking test failures.

Output uses 'PASS:'/'FAIL:' instead of the required '[ok]'/'[fail]' format. Rule 9 specifies step markers as [step], success as [ok], failure as [fail], and warnings as [warn], with [ok]/[fail] prefixed by 8 spaces for alignment.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace 'echo "PASS: ..."' with 'echo "        [ok] ..."' and 'echo "FAIL: ..."' with 'echo "        [fail] ..."' throughout the script.

issues.description: Script path is not quoted in the self.run() call: f"sh {script_path}". If the recipe_folder path contains spaces, the command would break. Rule 8 requires variables to be double-quoted in shell commands.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use f'sh "{script_path}"' to quote the path argument, e.g.: self.run(f'sh "{script_path}"', env="conanrun").

issues.description: Manifest uses 'software:' instead of 'name:' and nested 'build.system:' instead of flat 'build_system:' as specified in code style rule 14. The rule example shows 'name: zlib' and 'build_system: cmake' as top-level fields. The manifest header states it follows ARCHIVE-SPEC v2.0, which may define a different schema, but the code style rule does not distinguish between software-level and version-level manifests.
issues.fix_suggestion: If the code style rule applies to version-level manifests, change 'software: icoutils' to 'name: icoutils' and flatten 'build: system: autotools' to 'build_system: autotools'. If ARCHIVE-SPEC v2.0 supersedes the code style rule for version-level manifests, document the exception.

summary: Audit of icoutils 0.32.3 Conan recipe (11 changed files) found no P0 (deception) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues. The recipe is well-structured: conanfile.py uses Conan 2.x API correctly with proper method ordering, package_type='application', and bindirs set; conandata.yml has a valid HTTPS official source URL (savannah.gnu.org), legitimate 64-char SHA256, and properly declared patches; all 3 patches follow naming conventions and contain genuine HarmonyOS portability logic (config.guess/config.sub triplet support, umask fix for HMDFS); test_package executes real binaries (icotool/wrestool --version) satisfying R34; commands.json is correctly placed at software level with type='tool'. Four minor issues found: two P2 code-style violations in test_icoutils.sh (missing pipefail, non-standard output format) and two P3 suggestions (unquoted script path in test_package conanfile.py, manifest field naming deviation). Verdict: pass with style warnings.
